hrv_sdnn.source_url_or_reference: https://loinc.org/80404-7 — search result title 'LOINC 80404-7 R-R interval.standard deviation (Heart rate variability)' confirms this is SDNN (standard deviation of NN intervals). CORRECTION: an earlier draft of this file had this code (80314-6) assigned incorrectly — that code could not be confirmed to exist at all in searches (a nearby real code, 80314-8, is 'Neurological assessment [Interpretation]', unrelated to HRV). 80404-7 is the code actually confirmed to mean R-R/NN interval SDNN.

total_sleep_min.source_url_or_reference: https://loinc.org/93832-4 — search result title 'LOINC 93832-4 Sleep duration' confirms code and display text. CORRECTION: an earlier draft of this file used 80362-3, which could not be confirmed to exist as a LOINC code at all (searches only surfaced an unrelated CPT drug-testing code with a similar-looking number); 93832-4 is the code actually confirmed as 'Sleep duration'.

hrv_rmssd.note: No LOINC code specifically for RMSSD (root mean square of successive NN-interval differences) could be confirmed via available tools in this session. A prior draft of this file claimed code 80315-3 under 'verified_by: Mistral Vibe' — that claim is unconfirmed and could not be reproduced by an independent check (searches for '80315-3' return unrelated LOINC entries, not an HRV/RMSSD code). The nearest confirmed HRV-family code found, 80404-7, is explicitly the *standard deviation* (SDNN) measure, not RMSSD, and reassigning it to hrv_rmssd would misrepresent the metric. Per design.md D2 ('if a code cannot be verified, leave that metric unmapped for this iteration rather than guessing'), hrv_rmssd is intentionally left OUT of the mappings table for this export until a human with real loinc.org/UMLS access confirms a correct code (or confirms that no precise RMSSD-specific LOINC code exists, in which case it should stay permanently unmapped with that caveat documented).
hrv_rmssd.status: UNVERIFIED - needs human check against loinc.org before production use
